show.name: Berserk
show.summary: Berserk is a 25-part anime set in a dark fantasy/horror environment whereby the series focuses on the main character guts; a lone swordman who later meets up with a group of mercenaries called the band of the hawk. The leader of this band holds a strange necklace called a behelit that will only lead to evil.

show.name: Berserk
show.summary: In this world, is the destiny of mankind controlled by some transcendental entity or law? Is it like the hand of God hovering above? At least it is true and man has no control, even over his own will. In medieval times war raged throughout the countryside. Feudal lords would give large sums of money to mercenaries who could rid them of their enemies. One such mercenary is Guts. He wields a sword almost larger than he is and holds tremendous strength and courage. When he joins a band of mercenaries known as the Band of the Hawk, he finds a purpose to fight for other than money and helps the Hawks to become the most feared enemy on the battlefield. This anime is adapted from the manga of the same name created by Kentaro Miura. Warning: This show is not suitable for persons under the age of 18 due to extreme violence, gore, nudity, course language and mature content.

show.name: Berserk of Gluttony
show.summary: Fate Graphite is one of the forsaken. Cursed with the skill "Gluttony," he is ever starving, never sated…until the day he kills a dying thief and devours the man's strength—and his soul. The true hunger of Fate's Gluttony has awakened, and if he can learn to control his power, he will at last be the master of his own destiny.

show.name: Jakten på Berserk
show.summary: In Jakten på Berserk, Jarle Andhøy and his crew return to the Southern Ocean to try to find answers to what happened when Berserk disappeared. What made three experienced sailors sail into a predicted storm? Jarle Andhøy returns to Antarctica, where his ship Berserk and the crew of three disappeared in February 2011. Jarle and Samuel Massie were on the mainland when the boat unexpectedly left its safe haven, then sailed straight into a predicted storm.

show.name: Berserk mot Nordpolen
show.summary: This is the documentary from the adventurous expedition as far north as possible in the Arctic Ocean with the small sailing boat "Berserk". Against all odds, Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, and the king of the animals - David Mercy sailed in the wake of the Viking chieftain OTTAR and furthest north to the arctic polar edge. In a mixture of Viking and robber style, the ramshackle beach-chopping is done in Norwegian history, on Shetland and Norway, but the journey comes to an abrupt end when the Berserk expedition is thrown out of its own land on Svalbard.

show.name: Berserk mot Sydpolen
show.summary: Expedition leader Jarle Andhøy and his crew sail Berserk to the South Pole to plant the Norwegian flag at the pole 100 years after Amundsen. But while Jarle and Samuel are on the ice, Berserk disappears with three of the crew. Now, for the first time, we get to see the unique photos from the trip. This will be a strong story, and a story that will give us important insight into what happened before Berserk disappeared in the winter of 2011.

show.name: Berserk I Pionerenes Farvann
show.summary: Humorist Anne-Kat. Hærland and rock legend Petter Baarli make up the novice part of the crew on Jarle Andhøy's new Berserk expedition. The feelings are smeared in thick layers when they sail in the waters of the old whaling pioneers.

show.name: Berserk gjennom Nordvestpassasjen
show.summary: Jarle Andhøy, known from his many Berserk expeditions, gathers here a group of "dented" sons of Norway, to honor his polar heroes. The crew has minimal sailing experience where they muster in Puerto Rico. Berserk is set up by a group that would rather party than work, but slowly but surely the ship is finally seaworthy. The gang sets off on a voyage that surpasses previous expeditions in the North. In a bloodless Viking raid, our modern heroes are pursued by Canadian Coast Guard ships, defense and police in this incredible voyage...

show.name: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc - Memorial Edition
show.summary: The lone mercenary Guts travels a land where a century-old war is raging. His ferocity and skill in battle attract the attention of Griffith, the leader of a group of mercenaries called the Band of the Hawk. Guts becomes Griffith's closest ally and confidant, but despite all their victories, Guts begins to question why he fights for another man's dream of ruling his own kingdom. Unknown to Guts, Griffith's unyielding ambition is about to bestow a horrible fate on them both.

show.name: Berserk: Veien Til Valhall
show.summary: The berserk expedition began in 2002 when Jarle Andhøy, Alex Rosen, The Tamil Sami and the man who is crowned King of the Animals set the world record for furthest north in a sailboat. The further aim was to sail in the wake of the Viking chieftain Ottar to the Garda Kingdom in order to establish ties of friendship with the fraternal people in the East after the fall of the Soviet Empire. But the expedition was kicked out of Spitsbergen by the Governor of Svalbard and therefore had to cancel the friendship voyage to Russia. After 3 trials and a verdict in 2004, Berserk completed the journey through Russia, but was tried to be stopped by the Police, Coast Guard, and the Russian Northern Fleet, because the King of the Animals has illegally communicated with a polar bear. Berserk, The Road to Valhall deals with the journey of the adventure voyage in Norwegian history from the Sami in northern Norway, to Russia's backyard, through the aura of the Soviet era and ends in Snorri Sturlasson's story about the Viking king Odin in his guildhalls in Valhall.
